scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberately designed — colorblind-safe Tol palette, clear typographic hierarchy, percentile reference lines, leader-line callouts, and a complementary marginal box plot all show intentional craft, but the P25/P50/P75 labels collide with the subtitle text and the top-earner callouts crowd the upper-right with one label clipped at the edge.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Log scale is appropriate for log-normal income; no area-encoding violations; box plot uses correct Tukey whiskers; hardcoded xScale domain [14000,550000] fails the scaling metamorphic relation, and absent key function on .data(nodes) would corrupt identity on updates.
scores.stress_test_note: Fully static simulation (pre-computed, .stop()), no brush/zoom/transitions/dispatch; only interaction is pointer-event tooltips which correctly use the unified PointerEvents API and perform no DOM joins or data mutations on move.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Single-view with a 4-color Tol palette and pre-computed (non-animated) swarm keeps cognitive load low; the five leader-line callouts create minor visual tangle in the sparse right tail but don't impair reading the overall distribution.

proposer: Replaced the 6-line if/else-if chain for education assignment with an equivalent one-liner using `Math.floor(random() * 4)`, saving 5 lines. The uniform quartile thresholds map directly to floor arithmetic.
